full_agent_response:
Some common signs include:

- Being easily distracted
- Difficulty organizing tasks or managing time (procrastination, missed deadlines)
- Forgetfulness in daily activities
- Losing things frequently
- Restlessness or feeling "on edge" internally, even without obvious hyperactivity
- Impulsivity (interrupting others, impulsive decisions/spending)
- Difficulty following through on projects
- Trouble listening or staying present in conversations
- Emotional dysregulation (frustration, mood swings)

Adult ADHD often looks different from childhood ADHD — less running-around-the-room hyperactivity, more internal restlessness and executive function struggles.
